name: APK Studio
description: Build an installable Android APK from a small project: compile Java, package assets with aapt, dex with R8/D8, align with zipalign and sign with apksigner. The result is verified before it is offered, because an APK that fails to install on a phone is worse than no APK.

panels.title: APK Studio
panels.subtitle: Make a signed, installable APK from source you can see
